content.short: Foundation is an NFT listing platform built on the Ethereum blockchain.
content.description: Foundation, founded by Kayvon Tehranian and Matthew Vernon in February 2021, is an NFT marketplace built on the Ethereum blockchain. The platform enables users to sell NFTs, place offers, and collect individual works as well as whole collections, while offering search and filtering tools to discover a wide range of items. Developers can leverage Foundation's smart contracts to build on top of the protocol, enabling integrations and new experiences within the Foundation ecosystem.
